svg.text: Base plate 140 x 280 x 8; rubber pad the same size bonded under

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two clevis plates 100 long x 80 high x 8, 52 apart inside

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 17 mm pin hole in both, 70 above the ground, 50 from the clevis ends

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clevis centred 140 from each end of the base plate

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Chain lug 8 thick, 100 x 45, at the outer end; 14 mm hole 140 out

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld clevis and lug to the base with 5 mm fillets both sides

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clamp a 52 mm spacer between the clevis plates while welding

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Galvanize, then bond the pad with contact adhesive

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: lower leg sits between the clevis plates on an M16 bolt
